title: AG60095: Wasteland And Forest Management
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Problems and prospects of wastelands development and management, technology for
its identification and classification, technologies for management of
wastelands. Type of forestry and forest resources-delineation and
classification, ecological considerations, soil-water-nutrient-relationships,
stand dynamics, growth and density, estimates of production, reproduction
methods and generation, description and application of different systemsuniform, group strip, copping etc., preparation of management plans, regulation
and controls, socio- economic aspects of forest resources development and
management.
